description: Presidential Secretarial - Honorable President Having Consulted with the Hon. Prime Minister has Determined that the Ministerial Portfolio of Environment Should be in his Charge.
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (the Honourable President) and outlines the specific ministerial portfolio (Environment) that has been assigned to his charge. It contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed portfolio responsibility), meeting the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3). The notification specifically references the constitutional provision (Article 44(3)) and the determination of portfolio assignment, making it more than just a simple personnel announcement.
